title: Expressing Rapid Succession & Tactical Drama: alighogy... máris, hirtelen

sections.title: Describing sudden and overwhelming events
sections.content: Military engagements that turn abruptly use correlative constructions such as *alighogy... máris* ('no sooner had... than already...'), *rövid idő alatt* ('in a short time'), and *hirtelen* ('suddenly').

items.spanish: Alighogy megindult a magyar lovasroham, máris pusztító ágyútűzbe ütközött.
items.english: Hardly had the Hungarian cavalry charge begun when it already met devastating cannon fire.

items.spanish: Rövid idő alatt a magyar hadrend felbomlott a hatalmas oszmán túlerővel szemben.
items.english: Within a short time, the Hungarian battle line collapsed against overwhelming Ottoman superior numbers.

items.spanish: Tomori Pál kalocsai érsek, a sereg fővezére, hősiesen harcolva esett el a csatamezőn.
items.english: Pál Tomori, archbishop of Kalocsa and commander-in-chief, fell on the battlefield fighting heroically.
